news_items.headline: Bilibili Q1 2026 earnings beat on EPS, revenue misses estimate
news_items.summary: Q1 ended March 31, 2026: non-GAAP EPS 1.29 beat consensus 1.15; total net revenues RMB 7.37B fell short of RMB 7.60B est (~3% miss). Gross margin 37.1%, 15th consecutive quarter of margin expansion.

news_items.headline: Bilibili Q1 2026 call highlights: record profits, advertising revenue +30% YoY
news_items.summary: Advertising revenue grew +30% YoY (13th consecutive quarter of double-digit growth) driven by AI ad-efficiency. DAU 115M (+8% YoY), MAU 376M. Creators >1000 followers +30% YoY; avg creator income +24%.

news_items.headline: JPMorgan upgrades Bilibili to Overweight from Neutral, PT raised to $35 from $27
news_items.summary: JPMorgan analyst Daniel Chen upgraded BILI to Overweight (from Neutral) with a price target of $35 (up from $27), citing margin expansion trajectory and ad growth.

news_items.headline: Bilibili shares decline ~9.5% over past two weeks; ~21.4% over past month
news_items.summary: Despite Q1 EPS beat and bullish analyst posture, stock weakness persists. Price action shows ~9.5% drawdown over last 2 weeks and ~21.4% over last month.

news_items.headline: Upgraded earnings outlook might change the case for investing in Bilibili
news_items.summary: Earnings outlook upgraded by analysts following Q1 print; commentary frames the move as a potential turn in the investment case if margin trajectory holds.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: JPMorgan (Daniel Chen) upgraded to Overweight from Neutral, PT raised to $35 from $27 in last 7 days. Consensus rating Strong Buy across 31 analysts (30 Buy / 1 Hold / 0 Sell); avg PT $31.17 (high $38.08, low $21.14).

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 (quarter ended March 31, 2026) reported ~2026-05-15: non-GAAP EPS 1.29 beat vs 1.15; revenue RMB 7.37B missed RMB 7.60B est. Next quarterly report (Q2 2026) typically mid-to-late August historically; no firm date located. Street expects continued margin expansion (15th consecutive quarter) and double-digit ad growth; key risk is rising content/creator costs.
